subject: AWS Marketplace entitlement + runtime billing reconciliation plan
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace entitlement + runtime billing reconciliation plan

Hi team,

Following up on our previous intake, we'd like to align on the entitlement payload and runtime reconciliation flow for ACME (Acme Software) before we flip the production entitlement. High-level asks:

- Confirm the entitlement dimension name(s) AWS will use for SaaS subscriptions (e.g., product_family, sku_id, tenant_id).
- Provide sample entitlement JSON for the sandbox environment we can replay against our reconciliation job.
- Confirm metering event format and the expected cadence for reconciliation (real-time vs. daily aggregation).
- Agree on contract signature path and any marketplace fulfillment steps that will create the customer entitlement in AWS.

I've attached: redwood_saas_contract_draft_v3.pdf (SaaS contract with marketplace clause), metering-dimension-spec.yaml (our preferred payload), and a short smoke test plan.

Proposed timeline: internal sign-off by Friday 2026-05-22, sandbox reconciliation test week of 2026-06-01, production enablement 2026-06-15 (pending success). Please flag any blockers.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redwood_saas_contract_draft_v3.pdf (application/pdf), metering-dimension-spec.yaml (text/yaml), test-plan-smoke-run.md (text/markdown)

From: Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace entitlement + runtime billing reconciliation plan

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments — good starting point. A few quick answers and requests from our side:

- Entitlement dimension: we can support sku_id and tenant_id as primary dimensions. For multi-tenant sellers, we recommend a tenant_id claim that maps to the Marketplace Customer ID in our system.
- Sample entitlement: uploading a sanitized sample to the sandbox bucket now (you should have access). We'll email the S3 path.
- Metering: we support both event-level metering (events posted via the Metering Service API) and daily aggregated reconciliation files. For runtime usage (tokenized inference), event-level metering with a meterDimension of "runtime_units" is typical.
- Contract: Marketplace fulfillment requires a signed SaaS contract with the marketplace clause. Once that’s in place we create the entitlement and provision SKUs. Please ensure the DocuSign flow references your AWS seller account number.

One question: do you intend to do seller-side reconciliation (you push usage) or let AWS pull via reconciliation reports? If you push events, we need to coordinate API keys and the sample event schema.

I uploaded sandbox sample entitlement: s3://aws-marketplace-sandbox/rwi/acme/sample-entitlement-20260520.json

We can run a 30-minute tech sync tomorrow 2026-05-21 at 10:00 PT to walk through the payload and test steps.

Regards,
Asha Menon
Marketplace Partner Engineer — AWS Marketplace

Attachments: (s3 path shared)

Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace entitlement + runtime billing reconciliation plan

On Wed, May 20, 2026 at 12:03 PM Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments — good starting point. A few quick answers and requests from our side: ...

Thanks Asha — seller-side push is our plan. Redwood will emit metering events for runtime_units (granularity: tokens per 1e3) and we'll reconcile using a daily digest job that compares our internal billing vs. marketplace entitlements.

Action items from our side:
- I've attached an updated metering-dimension-spec.yaml with an added jwt_claim mapping and an example event payload sample.
- Please confirm if the tenant_id should be the marketplace-customer-id or internal_acct_id. We prefer marketplace-customer-id to avoid mapping tables if possible.
- DocuSign: please confirm required signer on the AWS side; we've prepared the package and sent to HelloSign (link below) for internal approval.

DocuSign / HelloSign link: https://app.hellosign.com/s/RWI-AWS-SaaS-2026

Proposed tech sync: Thu May 21 10:00 PT (you suggested 10:00 PT tomorrow) — please confirm dial-in and invite.

Thanks,
Priyom

Attachments: metering-dimension-spec.yaml (updated)

From: Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Lewis <sarah.lewis@acme-software.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace entitlement + runtime billing reconciliation plan

Thanks — meeting invite sent (Zoom). Dial-in and sandbox credentials are in the invite. A few clarifications before the call:

- tenant_id: please use the marketplace-customer-id. We'll propagate that as the canonical id in entitlement objects.
- JWT mapping: include claim "aws_mp_customer_id" and vendor_id if you can — it speeds up reconciliation.
- Signer required: the signer on the marketplace clause must be the authorized representative listed in your AWS seller profile. Once HelloSign/DocuSign completes, send the executed copy to aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com and we'll begin fulfillment.

Post-call we will provide a test entitlement id (ENT-TEST-XXXXX) and a temporary API key for metering calls to the sandbox meter endpoint. Use the API key from the invite to POST sample events. We'll also provide a reconciliation CSV template to match against.

Regards,
Asha Menon
Marketplace Partner Engineer — AWS Marketplace

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

On Thu, May 21, 2026 at 10:12 AM Marketplace Partner Team <aws-marketplace-ops@amazon.com> wrote:
> Thanks — meeting invite sent (Zoom). Dial-in and sandbox credentials are in the invite. ...

Quick technical notes from Redwood infra team ahead of the sandbox run:

- We'll POST meter events to the sandbox meter endpoint with payload fields: {"tenant_id","sku_id","timestamp","units","request_id"}. Mapping: tenant_id => aws_mp_customer_id.
- Our reconciliation job will accept a daily CSV from AWS (fields: date, tenant_id, sku_id, units_reported) and will compare against our internal aggregates; differences>1% will trigger manual audit.
- For the smoke test, we'd like to run both event-level and aggregated flows to validate both code paths. Proposed window: Tue 2026-06-01 09:00-11:00 PT.

Attaching the smoke test checklist: test-plan-smoke-run.md

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — appreciate the speedy coordination.

Asha
